Bloodthirsty.long: Empowered Monster will fire periodic volleys of bone projectiles
Bloodthirsty.empower: Empowered Monsters Attacks and Spells Impale on Hit

Butcher.short: Flings projectiles which open sores in the earth on hit
Butcher.long: Empowered Monster flings returning Projectiles of bone which Pierce all targets; Any target struck will cause a sore to open in the earth beneath them, which pours forth blood dealing repeated Physical Damage to Enemies in the area
Butcher.empower: Empowered Monster will deal 10% increased Damage

Conjurer.short: Creates portals, which release violent energies
Conjurer.long: Empowered Monsters creates two potals nearby. The first of these releases a beam of violent energy towards the second; After a short time, both portals vanish
Conjurer.empower: Empowered Monster has 50% chance to inflict Withered for 2 seconds on Hit

Crowkeeper.long: Empowered Monsters will regularly release novas of Crow Projectiles; Players Struck by a Crow will create a slow growing storm around them which detonates after a delay; Further storms cannot be attached until any attached storms on that target have already detonated
Crowkeeper.empower: Empowered Monster deals 30% increased Damage against Enemies on Low Life

Deathbringer.short: Causes beams of viscera and gore
Deathbringer.long: Empowered Monsters will cause highly damaging beams of viscera and gore, targeting nearby Players locations
Deathbringer.empower: Empowered Monster will have 40% increased Maximum Life

Doomsayer.short: Creates massive explosive blasts of blackfire

Dryad.long: Empowered Monster will cause Vengeful Vines to periodically sprout up by nearby Players; These Vines will then slam to deal Physical Damage on impact
Dryad.empower: Empowered Monster will leech a percentage of damage dealt as Life

Golemancer.short: Spawns fleshy simulacrums of blood and gore
Golemancer.long: Empowered Monster rips fleshy simulacra of blood and gore into being regularly; These then target the Player, slamming and inflicting Bleed before vanishing
Golemancer.empower: Empowered Monster has 30% increased Area of Effect

Houndmaster.short: Creates spectral wolves which explode into ice
Houndmaster.long: Empowered Monster sumons Spectral Wolves which leap in, howl, and then explode to deal Cold Damage; Howls from these Wolves will inflict Brittle on nearby Enemies
Houndmaster.empower: Empowered Monster has 300% increased Critical Strike Chance

Rot.short: Cursed broomsticks sweep across the area

Sanguine.short: Creates a deadly ring of boiling blood
Sanguine.long: Empowered Monster will have a ring of boiling blood surrrounding it, which deals heavy Physical Damage over time
Sanguine.empower: Empowered monster will regenerate 1% of Life per second

Stormcaller.long: Empowered Monster generates random leylines of electrical energy, which call down bolts of lightning after a short duration

Tempest.long: Volatile orbs of come into being nearby Empowered Monster; These orbs fire increasingly more frequent bolts of lightning to locations near them, then explode
Tempest.empower: Empowered Monster inflicts Conductivity on Hit

Torchbearer.long: Empowered Monster will create corpse bonfires nearby; These bonfires will periodically fire flaming mortars at enemies near them
Torchbearer.empower: Empowered Monster will gain 45% of Physical Damage as extra Fire
Torchbearer.duplicate: Empowered Monster will gain 90% of Physical Damage as extra Fire

Widlfire.long: Empowered Monster will create walls of Blackfire, which deal Fire Damage over time to Enemies within them
Widlfire.empower: Empowered Monster will inflict Flammability on Hit

danger_note: Added danger depends on the Fate cards you pick at the cauldron (up to 3); see the Fate list. Boss-specific changes: currently unknown.
